_notes: Indicative reference data for the demo. Figures are order-of-magnitude realistic (mid-2020s public index levels: Platts IODEX / Argus crude assessments / Guinea bauxite CIF China / Fastmarkets spodumene), chosen for internal consistency, not day-accuracy. Live assessments are what the LiveDataProvider will supply later. '_' keys are documentation, ignored by the loader.

iron_ore.benchmark_price_basis: USD/dmt CFR Qingdao, IODEX-style 65% Fe fines index (Simandou-grade high-Fe product)
iron_ore._sources: Benchmark level ~Platts IODEX 65% Fe CFR China; Fe/SiO2/moisture differentials in line with published Platts per-1%-Fe spreads. Default cargo: Capesize stem ex Morebaya (Simandou export terminal, Guinea).

crude_oil.benchmark_price_basis: USD/bbl delivered East Asia, medium-sour Gulf benchmark (Dubai/Oman-style)
crude_oil._sources: Benchmark level ~Dubai swaps; API/sulfur escalators in line with typical official-selling-price adjustment grids. Default cargo: VLCC stem ex Ras Tanura.

bauxite.benchmark_price_basis: USD/dmt CIF Yantai, Guinea 45% Al2O3 / 3% reactive SiO2 bauxite index level
bauxite._sources: Benchmark level ~Fastmarkets/CBIX Guinea bauxite CIF China, mid-2020s range. Moisture drives the wet-to-dry freight conversion only; the bauxite_linear formula prices Al2O3 and reactive silica. Default cargo: Capesize ex Kamsar (Boke region).

lithium_spodumene._sources: Config skeleton only: a valid CommodityProfile reusing the already-registered spodumene_linear formula, with no benchmark price, routes, freight or defaults yet. Proves a new commodity is pure configuration — no code change.
